required_implementations.semantics: Initialize independent model state before first solver step; never write displayed outputs.
required_implementations.acceptance: Initialization getters match all position/velocity/quaternion/rate fields at first step within 1e-9; airborne consistent with ground and model.

required_implementations.semantics: Apply gust to base wind; temperature/pressure determine ideal-gas density unless explicitly selected extended density; gravity/noise/weather feed plant or rendering, never silently ignore.
required_implementations.acceptance: Each nonzero field has actual consumer and E2 probe; gravity/forces/air-density impact E3, weather/illumination visible in video.

required_implementations.semantics: Supply/load/fault are stimuli. Outputs RPM/fuel/hydraulic/electrical are derived from subsystems, not echoed as model truth.
required_implementations.acceptance: All fields connected to subsystem equations and response probes; no fabricated observations.

required_implementations.semantics: Motor failures 1..6 force corresponding effective actuator to 0 without changing submitted input trace.
required_implementations.acceptance: Six independent faults and clear tested; generated contract and getter include fields 5,6.

required_implementations.semantics: Explicit model kind capability: demo controller quadrotor only; fixed-wing and six-motor missions must go to PX4/physical UUT/GCS.
required_implementations.acceptance: All task/geometry/waypoint actions consumed by selected controller and independently observed; cannot return model APPLIED for forwarding only.

required_implementations.semantics: GPS/IMU bias applies to sensor outputs, not true plant position/rates; command_delay is FIFO delay, packet_loss independent Bernoulli, sensor_delay output queue.
required_implementations.acceptance: True state and faulted sensor channels separately probed; initial simplistic model approximations replaced before acceptance.

required_implementations.semantics: Actual driver owns finite serial/analog/digital/CAN ports; raw bytes are not business model input until registered mapping.
required_implementations.acceptance: Hardware loopback/calibration/safety/electrical isolation required; capability false until qualified.

required_implementations.semantics: Decode/preprocess/PTS trigger actual frames; 2 RS422 sync pins owned by image injector, not UART.
required_implementations.acceptance: Frame consume probe and real output captured, phase/events synchronized within configured threshold.

required_implementations.semantics: Single interface receiver for both source implementations; E2 only generated by actual consumer/model write.
required_implementations.acceptance: Per-message sequence/transaction/E0..E3 tests plus unchanged code hash replacement.

required_implementations.semantics: GPS validity/fix and IMU freeze/age are sensor-only effects; never overwrite plant truth.
required_implementations.acceptance: T08 proves UUT sees NO_FIX/invalid and stale sample timestamps, and actual failsafe response.
